title: The Liquidity Surface
description: The Width Paradox as a 3D landscape: a Uniswap v3 LP's fee reward (colour) and rebalancing cadence (height) both climb toward the narrow-range edge. Slide volatility to watch the human-vs-agent frontier move.
controls: slide σ to walk the volatility axis and move the iso-vol contour
tap the surface to toggle the human weekly-cadence ceiling
